name: demand-letter-drafter
display_name: Demand Letter & Client Correspondence Drafter for Law Firms
description: One skill: /demand-letter. Attach a case folder with your facts and your firm's demand-letter template; the skill drafts a first-pass demand letter populated with those facts, or a plain-English client status-update email. Attorney sets the demand amount and reviews before sending. Assisted draft, always reviewed — never sends, files, or submits anything automatically.
